description: Queue a fresh AI visibility scan for one verified RankParse website, for example after the user fixed robots.txt or published llms.txt. The scan runs in the background within a few minutes; read the result with get_ai_visibility. Limited to one re-check per website per 10 minutes: a throttled call answers status "throttled" with retry_after_seconds and changes nothing. Fails with site_scan_not_verified for a website that is not verified and site_scan_plan_required (403) on the Free plan. 0 credits.

site_id.description: Logical RankParse website ID, from list_rank_tracking_sites or list_websites

name: recheck_ai_visibility
